title: ShiftSafe-CP / TargetAnchoredJK+: cross-laboratory calibrated prediction intervals for concrete compressive strength
description: Code, configuration files and archived results for the paper Reliable Cross-Laboratory Prediction Intervals for Concrete Compressive Strength under Distribution Shift (Computers and Concrete, accepted for publication, 2026). The repository contains the leave-one-domain-out protocol, the conformal methods (TargetAnchoredJK+ with the exact jackknife-plus, TargetOnlyJK+, StackedOnlyCP, AdaptiveSplitCP, TargetOnlyCP, TransferCal and split conformal prediction), the external comparators, the shift diagnostics, the result files of the registered confirmatory runs (seeds 142-191) and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the paper.
